display.title: Episode 540: Rabbi Chanina ben Dosa's Stone for the Beis HaMikdash (Tisha B'Av)
display.summary_short: Tisha B'Av falls on Shabbos this year; Rabbi Chanina ben Dosa brings a stone to the Beis HaMikdash with help from angels; the melody of Eichah; and a letter about helping the Rebbe recover.
display.summary_long: Broadcast the week of Tisha B'Av 5752, when the ninth of Av fell on Shabbos and the fast was pushed off to Sunday. Uncle Yossi gives the fast times and prays that, just as the fast was postponed, it will be postponed forever. The story: Rabbi Chanina ben Dosa, too poor to bring a gift for building the Beis HaMikdash, finds a perfectly square stone and wants to bring it to Yerushalayim, but cannot budge it. Five 'travelers', angels in disguise, offer to carry it, but it only moves once Rabbi Chanina puts his own little finger under it. In between, a boy leads the Shema and everyone gives tzedakah. The lessons: every mitzvah adds a stone to the third Beis HaMikdash, and 'you try your best and Hashem will do the rest'. After Tehillim for the Rebbe's recovery, Uncle Yossi speaks about music as Hashem's gift and plays the ancient melody of Eichah, the one song we may hear even on Tisha B'Av, ending with 'Hashiveinu'. He answers a girl's letter asking how children can help the Rebbe recover: daven, say Tehillim, learn more, give tzedakah and say the Twelve Pesukim every day. The show ends with candle-lighting time.
display.lesson: You try your best and Hashem will do the rest; every mitzvah adds a stone to the third Beis HaMikdash.
